title: Record that cover routing names no constant width factor
body:
## Summary
- The finite-cover note says fixed port routing uses a constant number of old width-`O(w)` interchanges. That paragraph does not name a constant `c_R`.
- The reviewed PR185 text repeats width-`O(w)` for routing and gives the high-part exchange width `k=O(w log e)`. The vendored PR387 proof treats 252 as unused slack.
- The published native stage-2 routing room is `4777557234646`. The comparison `log2(c_R)` against that room stays uninstantiated. No cutoff margin is recomputed, and there is no new exponent.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/stock-routing-factor/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/stock-routing-factor/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/stock-routing-factor`
- [ ] Confirm the registered replay on the maintainer's Python 3.12 checkout
